testcase.name: Scenario: Change magnification with the mouse wheel: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-gR5nAG/checkout/features/application/viewport-zoom/viewport-zoom.feature:5:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change magnification with the mouse wheel ✔ Given a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software ✔ And no navigation command is active ✔ When the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the direction that zooms out ✔ Then the block appears smaller in the viewport ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active ✔ When the user scrolls the mouse wheel over the block in the opposite direction ✔ Then the block appears larger than after zooming out ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active
